title: Bounded-size scheme representatives in a chosen big-site category
statement: Fix a big fppf site $\mathit{Sch}_{fppf}$ [def-pc-fppf-site] in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention], and let $\mathcal C$ be its chosen underlying full category of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with the underlying-category choice understood as in [def-sfb-stacks-big-site-category]. For a scheme $Z$, put $s(Z)=\max\{\aleph_0,|\mathcal B(Z)|,\sup_{V\in\mathcal B(Z)}|\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_Z)|\}$, where $\mathcal B(Z)$ is the set of affine open subschemes of $Z$ and $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_Z)$ is the ring of structure-sheaf sections on $V$. For an infinite cardinal $\kappa$, set $B(\kappa)=\max\{\kappa^{\aleph_0},\kappa^+\}$, where $\kappa^+$ is the least cardinal strictly greater than $\kappa$. For every object $T\in\mathcal C$ and every scheme $Z$ with $s(Z)\leq B(s(T))$, there exist an object $Z_0\in\mathcal C$ and an isomorphism of schemes $Z_0\cong Z$. In particular, this conclusion holds for the empty scheme. The object $Z$ need not already belong to $\mathcal C$.

source.place: Tag 000J, lemma-construct-category, clause (2), with equation-bound and section-categories-schemes; applies to every chosen underlying big-site category by topologies.tex Tag 021R, definition-big-fppf-site, clause (2).

proof.text: Unpack the chosen big fppf site using [def-sfb-stacks-big-site-category]: Topologies 021R (2) requires its already chosen underlying category to be an admissible $\mathit{Sch}_\alpha$, with all four conditions of Sets 000J. In particular condition (2) is available for that same category; one is not choosing a different big site. First work with $\mathcal C=\mathit{Sch}_\alpha$; the permitted full-skeleton version is handled below.

In condition (2) of [def-sfb-stacks-big-site-category], substitute $S=T$ and $W=Z$. Its hypotheses are precisely $T\in\mathcal C$ and the assumed inequality $s(Z)\leq B(s(T))$: the size and bound formulas are identical to those in the item. Obtain $S'\in\mathcal C$ and $e:Z\cong S'$. Set $Z_0=S'$ and take $e^{-1}:Z_0\cong Z$. Membership of $Z$ itself in $\mathcal C$ has not been used.

If $\mathcal C$ is a full skeleton of an admissible $\mathit{Sch}_\alpha$, then its object $T$ is still an object of $\mathit{Sch}_\alpha$. The preceding substitution gives $S'\in\mathit{Sch}_\alpha$ and $S'\cong Z$. By the defining representative condition of a full skeleton in [def-sfb-stacks-big-site-category], choose $Z_0\in\mathcal C$ with $Z_0\cong S'$. Composition with $S'\cong Z$ gives the asserted isomorphism in the original chosen category.

source.place: Tag 000J, lemma-construct-category, clause (2), under the skeleton convention of def-weil-size-convention.

proof.text: For $Z=\varnothing$, its only open subset is empty and its ring of sections has one element (the sheaf axiom for the empty cover). Thus its affine-open set has at most one element and the displayed formula gives $s(\varnothing)=\aleph_0$. For every $T$, $s(T)\geq\aleph_0$ and $s(T)\leq s(T)^+\leq B(s(T))$, so the size hypothesis holds. Apply the preceding steps to get an empty-scheme representative in $\mathcal C$.

lean.statement: theorem exists_bounded_size_representative (code : Scheme.{u} ↪ ZFSet.{u + 1}) (S₀ : Set Scheme.{u}) (α : Ordinal.{u + 1}) (hα : IsStacksBigSiteCategory code S₀ α) (T : StacksBigSiteCategory code α) : (∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, Z.cardinalSize ≤ max (T.obj.cardinalSize ^ Cardinal.aleph0) (Order.succ T.obj.cardinalSize) → ∃ Z₀ : StacksBigSiteCategory code α, Nonempty (Z₀.obj ≅ Z)) ∧ (∀ Z : Scheme.{u}, IsEmpty Z → ∃ Z₀ : StacksBigSiteCategory code α, Nonempty (Z₀.obj ≅ Z))
lean.note: The first declaration states the representative and empty-scheme clauses for the chosen admissible full category; the second states both clauses in any chosen full skeleton. The fppf topology does not enter the conclusion: the recorded category admissibility is exactly the underlying-category requirement of Stacks 021R (2).
